BL-1895 — lander_lib.bb (BL-1872) and bounded_run_lib.bb launch through setsid, which stock macOS does not ship: on a macOS host the lander never starts a land and every bounded run (the babysitter's checks among them) fails before it begins; both now start their child as a process-group leader through setsid when present and perl's setpgrp otherwise
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: From the coder's note (source). FIRM: setsid when it is on PATH, as today; otherwise perl's setpgrp, which stock macOS ships. The child is a process-group leader either way, so a group kill still reaches every grandchild (bounded_run_lib's reason for setsid). Medium severity, so it waits for you.
BL-1895 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1895" (or "reject BL-1895 <reason>") to act.
